name: byebar
description: ByeBar; Overlay & Popup Blocker (Chrome, Firefox, Safari)

scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:runtime && npm run icons && npm run stage:chrome && playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:headed: npm run build:runtime && npm run icons && npm run stage:chrome && playwright test --headed
scripts.validate:source: node scripts/validate-manifest.mjs && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test:run
scripts.validate: npm run check:generated && npm run check:icons && npm run validate:source
scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build:runtime && npm run icons && node scripts/lint-firefox.mjs
scripts.validate:packages: npm run build:store && npm run build:firefox
